Samira (sec): flagging an oddity: after the HSM key rotation in eu-west at 02:05 UTC, ~02:07 we got scattered mTLS failures across edge-proxy-eu-*. Some services saw transient 502s.
Dev (sre): I see the spike in handshake errors. Correlating with KMS key version change.
Tara (devops): rotation job ran: rotator invoked keys/keystore-eu v3 -> v4. Job log shows successful rotation but several KMS Decrypt calls returned AccessDenied before we applied new bindings.
LogBot: 
```
2026-05-03T02:07:12Z proxy-eu-a tls: handshake error: tls: failed to decrypt certificate: kms:AccessDenied
2026-05-03T02:07:15Z rotator job: unwrap attempt for key v4 failed: IAM Deny
2026-05-03T02:07:20Z proxy-eu-b tls: handshake error: client->server: TLS alert 40
```
Owen (infra): did we scope the new keystore role too tightly? Rotator principal is serviceAccount:keystore-rotator-eu@infra-prod. I think the rotation script also changed the key's IAM condition to require binary Authorization tag; that might have prevented decrypts from the rotator.
Samira (sec): can you pull the CloudAudit entries for KMS:Decrypt around 02:06-02:10 and confirm caller and condition? We need exact request attributes for postmortem.
Dev (sre): pulling now. I see Decrypt requests with status PERMISSION_DENIED and a proto field `denial_reason: condition-mismatch`. Caller is `serviceAccount:keystore-rotator-eu@infra-prod`.
Tara (devops): I rolled a scoped permissive binding to allow Decrypt for rotator at 02:12 UTC (region-only). That brought KMS decrypt successes at 02:13 and proxies recovered by 02:15.
Samira (sec): sec-bot, open incident SEC-2026-207 (P1) and attach ACL diffs and CloudAudit extract.
sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-207 created by Samira (sec). Link: https://incident.internal/SEC-2026-207
Owen (infra): interesting bit 99999we had added a condition on the key to require `resource.name` match and `request.time < 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z` for the old rotator principal during key promotion. That condition inadvertently prevented the rotator when the key version changed.
Dev (sre): recommendation: when rotating HSM-backed keys, apply new bindings before changing active key id. Also run a quick Decrypt smoke test with the principal in staging region.
Tara (devops): Agreed. I propose a pre-flight: 1) pre-provision binding to new key version 2) run `kms:Decrypt` smoke test 3) flip active key 4) verify proxies. I'll add this to rotator job.
Samira (sec): also add CI gate that verifies audit logs for Decrypt successes post-rotation. We need auditability in pipeline.
Owen (infra): there's another concern 99999some clients started reporting OCSP 'timeout' while proxies were waiting for cert unwrap. Need to ensure OCSP stapling is not a single point.
Dev (sre): Logs show OCSP latency rose from 50ms -> 450ms for a short window, probably due to retries while rotator blocked. No revocation failures.
Samira (sec): for postmortem include: timeline, root cause (ordering of binding vs key promotion + restrictive IAM condition), blast radius (eu-west proxies during 02:07-02:15), impact (brief increased 502s, a few client retries), remediation (pre-flight binding + smoke test + CI gate), and follow-ups.
Tara (devops): I'll attach the rotator job config and add a new canary that runs every 5m: attempt a decrypt of a test envelope and report via metrics.
Owen (infra): action item: export mapping of rotator principals -> kms key resource names across regions and commit to infra repo.
Dev (sre): security note 99999we should avoid granting broad KMS roles; prefer least privilege but ensure the conditions are correct. Add a changelog check for key IAM condition modifications.
Samira (sec): scheduling a brief 10:45 UTC sync to draft postmortem. Please include CloudAudit slices, rotator job logs, and proxy TLS logs.
LogBot: Saved audit extract to s3://redwood-sec-incidents/SEC-2026-207/audit-slice-1771001111.json
sec-bot: Follow-up SEC-FIX-2026-77 created for rotator preflight + CI gate (Tara)
